build_ActionPiece_model: build a T5-based ActionPiece model with configurable layers, heads, and vocabulary size for recommendation tasks
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the ActionPiece model with a batch dictionary to get logits and loss
generate_recommendations: generate recommendation sequences using beam search with ensemble ranking and nDCG scoring across multiple beams
run_beam_search: run beam search on input IDs with configurable max length, number of beams, and return sequences
review_beam_search_step: review the beam search step logic that calculates next token scores and selects top tokens for each beam
